pickerDescription: Frames are copied onto the board as pictures that link back to Figma, so everyone who can open the board sees them.
connectExplainer: Sign in to Figma once to pick frames from your files. Freero only reads the files you open here.
noFrames: This file has no frames at the top of its pages.
moreFrames: Only the first 60 frames are listed. Paste a link to a frame to place one further down.
placeFrames: {count, plural, =0 {Place frames} one {Place # frame} other {Place # frames}}
placed: {count, plural, one {Placed # frame from Figma} other {Placed # frames from Figma}}
refreshed: {count, plural, one {Refreshed # frame from Figma} other {Refreshed # frames from Figma}}
youNeedEditAccess: You need edit access to place frames
notOfferedHere: This server doesn’t offer Place from Figma
connectAgain: Connect Figma again: Figma no longer accepts Freero’s access to your account.
noAccess: Your Figma account can’t open this file.
notFound: Figma has no such file or frame.
renderEmpty: Figma couldn’t draw this frame (an empty or hidden frame draws nothing).
rateLimited: Figma is asking Freero to slow down. Try again in a minute.
notAFigmaLink: That isn’t a Figma file link.
figmaDidntAnswer: Figma didn’t answer. Try again in a moment.
